roots.title: Linear Programming
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Linear Programming; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

knowledge_statements.scope_note: Extraction-grounded informal characterization; excludes the passage's historical and application commentary.
knowledge_statements.statement_latex: \text{Linear programming concerns feasible plans restricted by linear inequalities, with plan quality measured by a linear function of the relevant quantities.}
knowledge_statements.statement_plain: Linear programming concerns feasible plans restricted by linear inequality constraints, with the quality of a plan measured by a linear function of the relevant quantities.
assumptions_latex: \text{The constraints on feasible plans are linear inequalities.}
\text{Plan quality is measured by a linear function.}
knowledge_statements.conclusion_latex: \text{Planning under these linear constraints and a linear quality measure is linear programming.}

children.title: LP Model Geometry
children.top_down_role: Structural foundations of finite-dimensional linear programming and its polyhedral feasible and solution sets; optimization algorithms and duality theory are exposed only through interfaces and cross-links.

children.title: LP Duality Certificate System
children.top_down_role: Structural organization of finite-dimensional linear-programming duality, optimality and infeasibility certificates, complementary solution geometry, status regimes, and certificate-producing computational interfaces.

children.title: LP Parametric Sensitivity Calculus
children.top_down_role: Postoptimal analysis of continuous linear programs under data variation, from local basis ranges through global parametric structure and solver interpretation.

children.title: Structured Large-Scale LP Regimes
children.top_down_role: Structural representations, integrality mechanisms, decomposition architectures, and computational regimes that distinguish specialized or very large linear programs.

children.title: Simplex Basis-State Algebra Architecture
children.top_down_role: Basis-centered representations and computational architectures for simplex methods, including network and implicit-column specializations; general simplex introductions, full duality theory, decomposition theory, and integer branch-and-price are owned elsewhere.

children.title: Simplex Initialization-Variant Reoptimization Taxonomy
children.top_down_role: Navigation for obtaining and transferring simplex bases, choosing among pivot orientations and representations, reoptimizing modified linear programs, and managing method-specific certificates and failure regimes.

children.title: Simplex Pivot-Control Dynamics
children.top_down_role: Navigation for simplex entering and leaving choices, step acceptance, degeneracy dynamics, anti-cycling theory, pivot-rule performance, and solver-facing control mechanisms.

children.title: Simplex Termination-Complexity Theory
children.top_down_role: Navigation for finiteness, cycling, pivot paths, pivot-rule complexity, geometric diameter interfaces, and explanations of practical simplex behavior.

children.title: Barrier Path Theory
children.top_down_role: LP logarithmic-barrier paths, their primal-dual geometry, path-following families, convergence theory, complexity theory, certificates, and failure boundaries; general barrier theory and implementation linear algebra remain external dependencies.

children.title: Primal-Dual Equation-Embedding Architecture
children.top_down_role: Structural organization of LP primal-dual equation systems, Newton representations, predictor-corrector families, homogeneous self-dual embeddings, certificates, and computational interfaces.

children.title: Barrier Computational Recovery Pipeline
children.top_down_role: Computational structures that connect LP barrier iterations to reliable linear solves, termination decisions, recovered bases, and downstream solver interfaces; barrier algorithm derivation and general LP duality remain outside this chapter.

children.title: Classical LP Interior-Point Families
children.top_down_role: Classical interior-point theory and method families specialized to linear programming, from affine and projective scaling through primal-dual path-following, potential reduction, initialization, convergence, certification, and numerical realization.

children.title: LP Algorithmic Complexity
children.top_down_role: Complexity theories, algorithm families, computational certificates, geometric regimes, and unresolved boundaries for solving linear programs; foundational LP theory and detailed algorithm derivations remain in their owning chapters.

children.title: LP Solver Implementation-Diagnostics Architecture
children.top_down_role: Implementation architecture, numerical reliability, solver selection, solution certification, and operational diagnostics for general-purpose linear programming solvers.
